test_title: English Language and Comprehension Mock Test 94

questions.question: Select the most appropriate question tag to fill in the blank.He isn't coming to the tour, _______?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'A' (is he) है।

questions.question: Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph. A. In the long term, this emotional exhaustion can affect overall well-being.B. Many people experience burnout not because of the work itself but because of how they manage their time and expectations.C. Often, the pressure to constantly perform leads to mental fatigue.D. Simple strategies like regular breaks and setting boundaries can reduce the intensity of burnout.E. Recognising the early signs of fatigue is crucial for prevention.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (B, C, A, E, D) है।

questions.question: Select the most appropriate proverb to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. She was disappointed about not getting the promotion, but her friend reminded her of the expression "there’s always a positive side to every difficulty".
options: out of sight, out of mind
a bird in the hand is worth two in the bush
every cloud has a silver lining
time and tide wait for no man
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'C' (every cloud has a silver lining) है।

questions.question:
Comprehension:Read the given passage and answer the questions that follow.The room in which the boys were fed was a large stone hall, with a copper at one end, out of which the master ladled the gruel at mealtimes. Of this festive composition, each boy had one porringer, and no more—except on occasions of great public rejoicing, when he had two ounces and a quarter of bread besides. The bowls never wanted washing. The boys polished them with their spoons till they shone again; and when they had performed this operation (which never took long, the spoons being nearly as large as the bowls), they would sit staring at the copper with such eager eyes, as if they could have devoured the very bricks of which it was composed.  Oliver Twist and his companions suffered the tortures of slow starvation for three months. At last, they got so voracious and wild with hunger that one boy, taller than the rest, hinted darkly to his comrades that unless he had another basin of gruel, he might eat the weak boy next to him. A council was held; lots were cast to determine who should walk up to the master after supper to ask for more. The lot fell to Oliver.  Evening arrived; the boys took their places. The master, in his cook’s uniform, stationed himself at the copper. Oliver rose, trembling, and advancing to the master, said: “Please, sir, I want some more.” The master was a fat, healthy man, but he turned very pale. Staring in stupefied astonishment, he clung for support to the copper. The assistants were paralysed with wonder; the boys with fear. “What!” said the master at length, in a faint voice. “More?” The master then aimed a blow at Oliver's head with the ladle, pinioned him in his arms and shrieked aloud for the beadle.Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Voracious
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (Ravenous) है।

The assistants were paralysed with wonder; the boys with fear. “What!” said the master at length, in a faint voice. “More?” The master then aimed a blow at Oliver's head with the ladle, pinioned him in his arms and shrieked aloud for the beadle.What did Oliver and the other boys have for their meals?
options: The boys had two bowls of gruel regularly and a bowl of meat on occasions.
They had a bowl of thick meat stew for regular meals and a bowl of fruit custard on occasions.
They had bowlfuls of nutritious meat soup every day, and on occasions, they were given eggs and a quarter of bread.

questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (The boys had a bowl of gruel for regular meals, and on occasions, they were given two ounces of gruel and a quarter of bread.) है।

options: The master was happy that Oliver was outspoken and wanted more gruel. This shows the healthy bond that the master and the inmates of the Workhouse enjoyed.
The master felt flattered, thinking that the gruel had been well prepared. The master was a good and caring person.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate proverb that is closest in meaning to the given sentence.Someone who has little knowledge about something often acts like they know everything
options: The grass is always greener on the other side
Empty vessels make the most noise
The pen is mightier than the sword
Rome wasn’t built in a day
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'B' (Empty vessels make the most noise) है।

questions.question: Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.To utter with a loud and vehement voice
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'C' (Vociferate) है।

questions.question: Select the correct option to complete the sentence with the appropriate one-word substitute.Despite the team’s efforts to resolve the dispute, their attempts were thwarted by an individual known for his constant opposition, a true ________.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'C' (naysayer) है।

questions.question: Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.A. As a police officer, I was an obvious target and was baited whenever it seemed safe to do so.B. In the end, the sneering yellow faces of young men that met me everywhere, the insults hooted after me when I was at a safe distance, got badly on my nerves.C. When a nimble Burman tripped me up on the football field and the referee (another Burman) looked the other way, the crowd yelled with hideous laughter.D. In Moulmein, in Lower Burma, I was a sub-divisional police officer of the town, and here anti-European feeling was very bitter.E. This happened more than once.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (D A C E B) है।

questions.question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.The great Dutch painter and master of Baroque painting, Rembrandt eschewed the sometimes ___________ dramatism of the Baroque painting of his time to focus on a hitherto unseen realism, creating portraits of extraordinary psychological penetration.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'C' (exaggerated) है।

questions.question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank and complete the following sentence. Homer's two epic poems, the Iliad and the Odyssey, have become __________ road maps in world mythology as they offer invaluable insights into early human society and illustrate how little has changed over millennia.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'A' (archetypal) है।

questions.question: Select the most appropriate idiom that can substitute the underlined segment in the sentence.When questioned, he tried to avoid addressing the main issue.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'B' (beat around the bush) है।
